title: Queen's chamber sarcophagus as healing device

tellings.quote: Yeah. That that uh sarcophagus they called it in in the queen's chamber. It's probably a healing device.

plain: A scientist named Steve Colbern, who studies objects he calls alien implants in human bodies, tells Michels that the stone box called a sarcophagus in the Queen's Chamber of the Great Pyramid at Giza is "probably a healing device." He offers it as his own view, and if he is right, the pyramid was built for a purpose far stranger than a tomb.
